subject: OrionTech: CAIQ evidence bridge & scheduling
messages:
From: Kelly Sanders <kelly.sanders@oriontech.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: security@oriontech.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping & evidence planning

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on — OrionTech is working through the CAIQ for our vendor review and we'd like to get a focused session with Redwood to map CAIQ questions to your artifact set. A couple of things we care about up front:

- Logging and retention (we need clarity on rolling logs vs. aggregated metrics)
- Key management and HSM integration details for private deployments
- Network segmentation for Dedicated deployments and evidence for VPC peering

I've attached our annotated CAIQ (orion_caiq_questions_5.18.pdf) with a handful of high-priority questions flagged. Can we do a 30–45 minute call next week to walk the top ~15 items and agree an "evidence bridge" (mapping) so our procurement and security teams can close the review?

Proposed times: Tue 5/25 10:00-11:00 PT, Wed 5/26 14:00-15:00 PT, or Thu 5/27 08:00-08:45 PT. If you prefer, share a couple windows and we'll pick one. Also include any pre-read materials you think helpful.

Best,
Kelly
Kelly Sanders
Senior InfoSec Manager, OrionTech
(Attachment: orion_caiq_questions_5.18.pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kelly Sanders <kelly.sanders@oriontech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence planning

Hi Kelly — thanks, we can absolutely do this.

Quick plan:
1) We'll produce an "evidence bridge" spreadsheet that maps each flagged CAIQ question to a recommended artifact (logs, configs, runbooks, screenshots, or policy pages).
2) We'll draft CAIQ responses for your review (level-set wording vs. raw evidence).
3) On the call we can triage anything that requires a deeper artifact pull (logs, packet captures, or SOC exports).

Tue 5/25 10:00 PT works for us — I'll tentatively book that and send a calendar invite. Marissa will own the mapping and attach the first pass; David will handle log/retention specifics and can share example extracts.

Pre-reads I will share: evidence_bridge_template.xlsx (blank) and a short mapping guide.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: evidence_bridge_template.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Kelly Sanders <kelly.sanders@oriontech.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping & evidence planning

Folks — attached is a first-pass mapping and a draft of CAIQ responses for the flagged questions. I prioritized the items Kelly highlighted in the PDF and noted where we can supply screenshots vs. where we should prepare extracts. Highlights:

- Logging: We can provide retained raw audit logs for 90 days (configurable to 180 on Dedicated). See row 12–18 in the evidence map.
- Key management: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM for Private. I'll include the HSM vendor model and a key rotation excerpt.
- Network: For Dedicated we have explicit VPC peering diagrams and routing ACL samples; included sample VPC peering export (redacted).

Attachments in this email: redwood_evidence_map_v1.xlsx, caiq_draft_responses_v0.3.md. Please review ahead of the call and flag anything you want us to surface live.

Proposed call agenda (30–45m):
- 5m: introductions & scope
- 20m: go through top 12 CAIQ items and agree evidence
- 10m: action items and owners

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood_evidence_map_v1.xlsx; caiq_draft_responses_v0.3.md)
